title: {p} & {v} Broth Noodles
steps: Simmer broth or water with the {spice} and the {sauce} for 10 minutes.
Add the {p} and simmer until {doneness}. Boil any eggs hard, 10 minutes, and peel.
Cook the {s} separately to the pack time, then drain.
Add the {v} to the broth for the last 3 minutes, then ladle over the {s} in bowls.
tip: Make the veg half the bowl, use a light hand with the soy and keep the broth the main event.
